results.text: Efficacy and Safety of Enalapril and Propranolol on Neurologic Recovery After Isolated Severe Traumatic Brain Injury: A Randomized Clinical Trial. results.text: [Evaluation of the effectiveness of a cicletanine-enalapril combination in hypertensive patients].
